Build me a compact Moroccan medina street inspired by Chefchaouen, with a tranquil, sunlit atmosphere and roughly fifteen to twenty tightly adjoining two- to four-story buildings arranged along both sides of a broad, straight road. Layer the irregular façades with recessed courtyards, narrow alleys, horseshoe-arched passages, exterior stair landings, projecting timber galleries, small balconies, and overlapping rooflines. Construct the road from worn, slightly reflective paving with broad shallow puddles, pale raised curbs, and narrow dark cobbled sidewalks. Finish the buildings in weathered cobalt and powder blue, white, pale turquoise, dusty coral, and peach stucco, frequently exposing dark stone masonry beneath chipped plaster. Use predominantly orange terracotta roof tiles, punctuated by pale-blue tiled pyramidal roofs and flat blue terraces. Make a tall blue tower house with a dark wooden room projecting below its roof the central landmark. Frame deep-set wooden doors and arched windows with alternating blue-and-white bands, then add flowering vines, tall palms, twin-lantern streetlights, and occasional wooden benches.

Build me a compact Moroccan medina street inspired by Chefchaouen, with a tranquil, sunlit atmosphere and roughly fifteen to twenty tightly adjoining two- to four-story buildings arranged along both sides of a broad, straight road. Layer the irregular façades with recessed courtyards, narrow alleys, horseshoe-arched passages, exterior stair landings, projecting timber galleries, small balconies, and overlapping rooflines. Construct the road from worn, slightly reflective paving with broad shallow puddles, pale raised curbs, and narrow dark cobbled sidewalks. Finish the buildings in weathered cobalt and powder blue, white, pale turquoise, dusty coral, and peach stucco, frequently exposing dark stone masonry beneath chipped plaster. Use predominantly orange terracotta roof tiles, punctuated by pale-blue tiled pyramidal roofs and flat blue terraces. Make a tall blue tower house with a dark wooden room projecting below its roof the central landmark. Frame deep-set wooden doors and arched windows with alternating blue-and-white bands, then add flowering vines, tall palms, twin-lantern streetlights, and occasional wooden benches.
